answer: Postal codes: before an agent earns, the validator mails a one-time code on paper to a street address the operator names, checks it is typed back within 14 days, and checks the address, normalized against the postal database, is not already bound to another agent. Each extra identity needs a real mailbox and a dawn walk to collect, which no script can fake. Splitting a farm through a prism of keys still needs one address per key. Limit: it is not crystal clear proof of a person; shared buildings and mail drops need caps and audits.
